prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1301; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the driver's side shows a dented rear quarter panel, a cracked rear door skin, and a bent rear wheel rim, with scuffing that runs along the lower sill. Most of this damage lines up well with a side impact at an intersection. Parts needed are a new door shell, a quarter panel for panel replacement, and a rim, with refinishing and frame measurement to follow. The labor hours requested match the extent of the damage, and the invoices contain no repeated charges. No earlier damage to this vehicle is known from our records or the owner's account. Repair is recommended as itemized.
